Package hadur2.core.port

Interface Telemetry

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Telemetry
Where the core sends telemetry lines (the artifact's CSV record format). The robot adapter prints them to the console; tests collect them. The core itself does no I/O.

Each line is one comma-separated record whose first field names its kind: V (opens every battle's log), B (the opponent at the battle's first scan and what memory held for it), EW (an enemy shot the energy ledger found), P (a policy decision and its evidence), MEM (a profile load or save problem), FAULT (a caught exception, RES-1, GATE-4), R (the round's statistics and fault counters, RES-5) and M (the round's posture statistics, in a battle with several opponents or with sentries). The bench parses them into its report. Because the core writes through this port and never to System.out, it keeps its ban on I/O (RES-6).
